name: SkuPilot – Bulk Product Editor for WooCommerce
author: wpvoid

sections.description:
WooCommerce’s built-in product editor can be painfully slow for stores with hundreds or thousands of products. Changing prices for a sale, updating stock, or reorganising categories often means opening products one by one.

SkuPilot gives store managers a focused bulk product editor inside WordPress admin. Filter the products you want, select visible products, then bulk-update prices, sale dates, stock, categories, and tags from one screen.

Every bulk operation includes progress tracking and an undo snapshot, so large catalogue changes feel controlled instead of risky.

Free

  • Spreadsheet-style product table – sortable, searchable, and paginated
  • Quick filter chips – All, In Stock, Out of Stock, On Sale, Simple, Variable, Draft, and Published
  • Advanced product filters – filter by price range, stock range, category, tag, date range, and product type
  • Bulk price editing – set exact prices, increase/decrease by percentage or fixed amount, or multiply prices
  • Sale price management – set sale prices, remove sale prices, and set sale start/end dates
  • Price rounding – round prices after changes, including .99, .95, .49, whole number, ceiling, and floor rounding
  • Bulk stock editing – set stock quantity, increase/decrease stock, and change stock status
  • Bulk category editing – add, remove, or replace product categories
  • Bulk tag editing – add, remove, or replace product tags
  • Bulk move to Trash – send selected products to the WordPress Trash with undo support
  • Undo history – restore the last 50 bulk operations from snapshots
  • Flexible selection – select visible products or choose products manually
  • Variable product support – edit parent products and view product variations
  • Progress tracking – watch large operations as they run in batches
  • Basic CSV export – export selected products
  • Admin-only assets – no storefront CSS or JavaScript is loaded
  • HPOS compatible – built with WooCommerce product APIs and HPOS compatibility declared

⭐ Premium

  • ⭐ Bulk edit product titles – set titles, add prefixes, add suffixes, or find and replace text
  • ⭐ Bulk edit descriptions – update full product descriptions or short descriptions
  • ⭐ Bulk edit SKUs – set, prefix, suffix, or find and replace SKUs
  • ⭐ Bulk edit weight and dimensions – update product weight, length, width, and height
  • ⭐ Bulk set or remove featured images – choose an image from the media library and apply it to selected products
  • ⭐ Bulk edit product status – publish, draft, or pending selected products
  • ⭐ Bulk edit visibility and featured status – update catalog/search visibility and featured product flags
  • ⭐ Inline cell editing – click supported table cells to edit values directly
  • ⭐ Quick Discount – apply a percentage or fixed sale discount in one click
  • ⭐ Conditional Price Rules – run pricing rules such as “if regular price is greater than 50, decrease by 10%”
  • ⭐ Scheduled operations – schedule supported price and stock changes for a future date/time
  • ⭐ CSV import – upload a CSV, preview rows, map columns to WooCommerce fields, and match products by SKU or product ID
  • ⭐ Extended CSV export – export selected products with extended product fields
  • ⭐ Activity log – review an audit trail of bulk operations
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “SkuPilot”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Go to Products → Bulk Editor in your WordPress admin
sections.faq:
Does this work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. SkuPilot declares HPOS compatibility and uses WooCommerce product APIs for product queries.

Is SkuPilot compatible with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes. SkuPilot requires WooCommerce 8.0 or newer and is built with official WooCommerce product APIs. For major WooCommerce updates, test on staging first.

Does it affect my site’s frontend performance?

No. SkuPilot only loads inside WordPress admin, not on your storefront.

What is the difference between Free and Premium?

Free includes the core bulk editor: filters, prices, sale prices, stock, categories, tags, Trash, undo, and selected-product CSV export.

Premium adds content editing, images, weight/dimensions, status/visibility, inline editing, CSV import, extended export, quick discounts, rules, scheduling, and activity logs.

Can I bulk edit product titles and descriptions?

Yes, with Premium. You can bulk edit titles, full descriptions, and short descriptions.

Can I filter products by custom taxonomies?

Not yet. SkuPilot supports WooCommerce product categories and tags.

Can I bulk delete products?

Yes. Free and Premium can move selected products to the WordPress Trash. Products are not permanently deleted.

How does undo work?

SkuPilot snapshots products before each bulk edit. Click Undo to restore the previous values.

Is there a limit on how many products I can edit at once?

No fixed limit. SkuPilot processes products in batches for reliability.

Can developers rebuild the admin assets?

Yes. The TypeScript/React source is included in the src directory. Run npm install and npm run build from the plugin directory to rebuild the compiled admin assets.
